products.name: SHIRMANI Supreme Text & Language 1517
products.description: Smart browser tool for refining text, counting language signals, cleaning spaces, and generating reusable copy.
products.long_description: SHIRMANI Supreme Text & Language 1517 is a self-contained browser product for practical text and language work. Paste text, clean repeated spaces, inspect words, characters and lines, and generate a reusable refined-text output. It runs locally in the browser and does not claim external AI execution.
